description: This is the main activity source file for an Android application that manages app shortcuts. It includes logic for adding, enabling/disabling, and removing website shortcuts, and interacts with Android's ShortcutHelper to manage dynamic and pinned shortcuts.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity, managing app shortcuts, user interactions, and UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, restores shortcuts, and handles intent actions.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the list of shortcuts when activity resumes.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Handles add button click to invoke shortcut addition.

methods.name: addWebSite
methods.description: Displays dialog to input website URL and initiates shortcut addition.

methods.name: addUriAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous task to add website shortcut and refresh list.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Updates the displayed list of shortcuts.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks within list items to enable/disable or remove shortcuts.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Constructs a string describing the shortcut's types (dynamic, pinned, disabled).
